notes: Studio at 100 W. 2nd Street, Boston, MA 02127, phone 617-268-7620. Photography, 3D design, creative technology, animation and video are Boston only. AFH also has a Brooklyn site with different rules. Work permit rule not checked.
name: Artists For Humanity Teen Jobs
what_you_do: Start with 36 hours of unpaid Foundation Studio training, then get paid to work in an art or design studio such as painting, graphic design, photography, 3D design, animation or video.
who_can_apply: Teens enrolled in a Boston Public School, or who live in Boston (night, day, homeschool or GED programs count). You must be authorized to work in the US. No art experience needed. No age range is listed.
pay_detail: Paid, rate not stated on the page. The first 36 Foundation Studio hours are unpaid volunteer hours.
duration: School year: Tue to Thu, 3:00 to 6:00 p.m. Summer: Mon to Thu, 11:00 a.m. to 5:15 p.m.
deadline_text: School-year applications are rolling, monthly. Interview invitations went out Oct 9, 2026 for the November group. Hiring pauses through December 2026 and resumes January 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online, then interview with the Teen Interview Team. First come, first served. Accepted teens do onboarding and work paperwork, then Foundation Studio, then start paid work. After two interview invitations you must reapply to be contacted again.
